//: Merge this target into apps/<expo-app>/project.json. It re-applies app.json and the config plugins to the committed native folders and fails when that changes anything, i.e. when someone changed the Expo config without running prebuild. No --clean (and no pod install), so it runs on Linux; leftovers of removed plugins and manual native edits are left to code review.

commands: test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- ios android)" || { git status --short -- ios android; echo 'ios/ or android/ is out of date: run "npx expo prebuild" and commit the result' >&2; exit 1; }
